summary: Clearwater County, ID tower: a 1910 crow's nest, a 100-foot steel tower from 1934, torn down in 1999; sources disagree on staffing after the 1970s.

facts.design: 100-foot steel tower (listed as an Aermotor, or as an MC-39 model)
facts.status_note: Torn down in 1999 per two listings; Forest Lookouts says only that it was removed, with no date

staffing.status: in use into the 1970s per two listings; Idaho Fire Lookouts also names Mr. and Mrs. Kirkpatrick as staff in 1981

facts.agency: Clearwater-Potlatch TPA (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com); Clearwater Timber Protective Association (Forest Lookouts)

visit.trail_note: Labeled Drive-Up by Idaho Fire Lookouts; the tower is gone and no source says whether the site is open now

events.note: 100-foot steel tower at the north end of the ridge
Power line about four miles long built to the lookout, per an annual report quoted by Forest Lookouts
Mr. & Mrs. Kirkpatrick listed as staff; does not fit the 1970s end date given by two listings

evidence.supports: crow's nest in 1910; 100-foot steel tower built in 1934; in use into the 1970s; torn down in 1999
evidence.quote: Developed with a crow's nest in 1910, this 100' steel Aermotor tower, built in 1934, was in use into the 1970's. It was torn down in 1999.

evidence.supports: 100-foot steel MC-39 tower at north end of ridge, 1934
evidence.quote: 1934: 100' steel MC-39 tower at north end of ridge. (Kresek)
The tower was active until the 1970’s.

evidence.supports: power line about four miles built to the lookout in 1960
evidence.quote: Power line built to Brown's Creek Lookout, a distance of about four miles.

evidence.supports: 1960 entry quotes the Clearwater TPA annual report
Clearwater Timber Protective Association agency name

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Fire Lookouts says Aermotor and Forest Lookouts says MC-39; the two descriptions appear to refer to the same tower type, so the story gives both names

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the last staffed years: two listings say in use into the 1970s, while Idaho Fire Lookouts also lists Mr. and Mrs. Kirkpatrick in 1981; the story reports this without resolving it. Agency naming differs across listings (Clearwater-Potlatch TPA vs Clearwater Timber Protective Association); the brief's name matches only Forest Lookouts. Brown Creek #2 is a separate record and is not covered here. A Clearwater National Forest history PDF (foresthistory.org) quotes a memoir about a 'Browns Creek Lookout' staffed by a woman from Weippe, but the text does not say which station or year, so it is left out.
